lines.say: This week, Iran's Revolutionary Guard reported three tankers on fire in the Strait of Hormuz.
But in 1987, in these same waters, tankers dragged America into a war with Iran.
Kuwait put its tankers under the American flag, and US warships escorted them through the Gulf.
Mines hit the very first convoy. American helicopters caught an Iranian ship laying more.
In April 1988, the US Navy sank or crippled half of Iran's working navy in a single day.
Three months later, the cruiser USS Vincennes shot down an Iranian airliner.
All two hundred and ninety people on board were killed.
Now the tankers are burning again, in the same waters.
The whole story is in the full video.
